formatNotes.valuesByMode: Literal values are preserved per Figma mode.
formatNotes.aliases: A value containing $alias preserves the original Figma variable reference. $target carries stable Figma IDs and keys.
formatNotes.colors: Color components remain in Figma's 0-1 sRGB range; hex is included as a convenience.
formatNotes.styles: Text and effect styles are composite definitions. boundVariables preserves any variable bindings found on the style.

tokens.name: alpha-black/56
tokens.description: Black at 56% opacity, reserved as the primitive for modal scrims.

tokens.name: overlay/modal
tokens.description: Use as the scrim fill behind standard modals and focused confirmation flows.

tokens.name: font-family/display
tokens.description: Poppins for display and heading text.

tokens.name: font-family/body
tokens.description: Inter for body and interface text.

tokens.name: blur/background-sm
tokens.description: Use for lightweight floating controls and compact action bars.

tokens.name: blur/background-md
tokens.description: Use for sticky navigation, popovers, and floating panels.

tokens.name: blur/background-lg
tokens.description: Use for dialogs, drawers, and immersive overlay surfaces.

tokens.name: blur/modal-overlay

tokens.name: button/state/soft-filled/hover-layer

tokens.name: button/state/soft-filled/pressed-layer
tokens.description: Pressed overlay for soft-filled Secondary buttons.

text.name: display/hero
text.description: Use for the main hero headline on landing pages or high-priority overview screens.

text.name: heading/page-med
text.description: Use for page titles when a quieter, less dominant hierarchy is appropriate.

text.name: heading/page-semi
text.description: Use for primary page titles at the top of core screens and major flows.

text.name: heading/section-med
text.description: Use for section titles when the surrounding content needs a softer hierarchy.

text.name: heading/section-semi
text.description: Use for primary section titles that divide major content areas.

text.name: heading/subheading-med
text.description: Use for secondary headings that introduce supporting groups of content.

text.name: heading/subheading-semi
text.description: Use for strong secondary headings that need clearer separation.

text.name: heading/component-med
text.description: Use for card, panel, and component titles with a subtle emphasis.

text.name: heading/component-semi
text.description: Use for card, panel, and component titles that need stronger emphasis.

text.name: body/l-reg
text.description: Use for longer introductory copy or prominent descriptions in spacious layouts.

text.name: body/l-med
text.description: Use when introductory or descriptive copy needs emphasis without becoming a heading.

text.name: body/m-reg
text.description: Use for standard paragraphs, long descriptions, and everyday interface copy.

text.name: body/m-med
text.description: Use for short body copy that needs emphasis within content or controls.

text.name: body/s-reg
text.description: Use for secondary supporting details placed near primary content.

text.name: body/s-med
text.description: Use when small supporting details need stronger emphasis.

text.name: caption/reg
text.description: Use for metadata, timestamps, source labels, and non-interactive annotations.

text.name: caption/med
text.description: Use for metadata that needs emphasis, such as status context or selected values.

text.name: button/l
text.description: Use for labels in large primary or secondary buttons.

text.name: button/m
text.description: Use for labels in standard-size buttons across the interface.

text.name: button/s
text.description: Use for labels in compact buttons and dense toolbar actions.

text.name: tabs/item
text.description: Use for labels that switch between peer content panels or views.

text.name: input/text
text.description: Use for entered values and placeholders inside text input controls.

text.name: input/helper
text.description: Use below form fields for hints, character guidance, and validation messages.

text.name: badge/label
text.description: Use for short status, category, and tag labels inside badges.

text.name: tooltip/reg
text.description: Use for short explanatory text that clarifies a nearby control, label, or value.

text.name: tooltip/med
text.description: Use for the key phrase or value in a tooltip when it needs stronger emphasis.

text.name: number/xl-med
text.description: Enable Tabular Figures for aligned data columns. Use for the most important metrics, such as total revenue, account balance, or a primary dashboard KPI.

text.name: number/xl-reg
text.description: Enable Tabular Figures for aligned data columns. Use for a large key metric when visual emphasis should remain restrained, such as a primary KPI in a balanced dashboard layout.

text.name: number/l-med
text.description: Enable Tabular Figures for aligned data columns. Use for card-level metrics, such as counts, conversion rates, or summary values within dashboard cards.

text.name: number/l-reg
text.description: Enable Tabular Figures for aligned data columns. Use for card-level metrics that need clear hierarchy without the stronger emphasis of the medium-weight variant.

text.name: number/m-reg
text.description: Enable Tabular Figures for aligned data columns. Use for standard data values in lists, tables, charts, and dense dashboard views.

text.name: number/m-med
text.description: Enable Tabular Figures for aligned data columns. Use for standard values in tables, lists, charts, and dense dashboards when faster numeric scanning is needed.

text.name: number/s-reg
text.description: Enable Tabular Figures for aligned data columns. Use for secondary numeric details, such as timestamps, axis labels, comparison values, and supporting metadata.

text.name: number/s-med
text.description: Enable Tabular Figures for aligned data columns. Use for compact supporting data, including timestamps, axis labels, comparison values, and metadata that needs extra clarity.

text.name: display/hero-l
text.description: Use for a prominent landing-page or campaign headline.

text.name: display/hero-xl
text.description: Use for a short, high-impact headline in a spacious desktop hero.

effect.name: Shadow/s
effect.description: Use only for subtle separation on resting cards and compact non-button controls when fill or border contrast is insufficient. Do not use on Button components.

effect.name: Shadow/m
effect.description: Use for raised non-button surfaces such as inputs, tooltips, and compact popovers. Do not use on Button components.

effect.name: Shadow/l
effect.description: Use for clearly floating or temporary surfaces such as popovers, menus, and dialogs. Do not use on Button components.

effect.name: Blur/background-sm
effect.description: Use for lightweight floating controls and compact action bars.

effect.name: Blur/background-md
effect.description: Use for sticky navigation, popovers, and floating panels.

effect.name: Blur/background-lg
effect.description: Use for dialogs, drawers, and immersive overlay surfaces.

effect.name: Modal overlay/default
effect.description: Apply with the overlay/modal fill variable behind standard modals and focused confirmation flows.
